description:
The ladder is currently PUSHED: the seal schedules DeriveTransportPlan + MaterializeRoot as follow-ups (root.rs:363-366, conditional on closure_changed); each rung pushes the next (MaterializeRoot->DeriveAbiReady artifact.rs:163; DeriveAbiReady->DeriveEmissionReady artifact.rs:228-231; DeriveEmissionReady->LowerBackendProgram artifact.rs:502-505). Native lowering is already demand-only (native.rs comment ~89-95) and the JIT/AOT/dump front doors transitively demand LowerNativeProgram(root); the interp front door demands BackendProgram(root).

DO: delete the seal's follow_up pushes of DeriveTransportPlan/MaterializeRoot (root.rs:363-366) and the rung-to-rung follow_up pushes (artifact.rs:163,228-231,502-505). Rely on the root compile entry demand-pulling the TOP artifact (BackendProgram/NativeProgram), which transitively pulls each rung via its existing wait+follow_up-on-prerequisite path. This is the last push-based machinery downstream of the analyzer frontier (roots aside).

REMOVES: all proactive artifact-ladder seeding; the ladder is pure pull. One commit. Blocked by fz-463.8. Blocks fz-463.6.
title: Convert the artifact ladder from push to demand-pull
